answer: Require every new identity to earn attestations from three mutually unconnected trust clusters before it can claim rewards: like a vine that must root in three separate patches of soil, not one pot. A lone agent joins different communities over time and gathers copper-solid endorsements from each. A farm growing a thousand yarrow lookalikes in one greenhouse fails, because its cluster can supply only one of the three roots - buying entry into two more independent groups per fake costs negotiation, history, and trust no script can mass-produce.
